item.title: PetroChina First-Half Profit Rises 22% on Higher Oil Prices
item.description: PetroChina Co. posted a 22% increase in first-half profit as a surge in global energy prices boosted upstream revenue at China’s biggest oil and gas producer.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News

item.title: Aliko Dangote's Daughters Join Succession Plan
item.description: As Aliko Dangote prepares for Africa's largest IPO, he is breaking tradition by bringing his three daughters into the group's succession plan. Mariya, Halima, and Fatima have spent more than ten years working quietly behind the scenes of their father's multi-billion dollar conglomerate, which spans industries from cement and sugar to fertilizer and refined crude. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nepal Races to Find Missing Amid Threats of Further Flooding
item.description: Nepal raced to find thousands still missing as rising water levels and worsening weather threaten to hamper rescue efforts, five days after a glacial collapse unleashed catastrophic flooding along the border with China.
item.dc:creator: Dan Strumpf and Sankalp Phartiyal

item.title: Bloomberg This Weekend 8/29/2026
item.description: The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by Schwab Head of Macro Research and Strategy Kevin Gordon, Allspring Global Investments Head of Equity Investments Ann Miletti, Child Online Safety Activist Beeban Kidron and Content Creator Macy Gilliam. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Meta Child Safety Deal Puts Rivals on Notice
item.description: Meta’s child safety settlement includes new protections for young users and is increasing pressure on other social media platforms to adopt similar safeguards. UK House of Lords National Security Strategy Committee member and Online Safety Activist Baroness Beeban Kidron is on Bloomberg This Weekend and says the bigger impact may come from forcing technology companies to take greater responsibility for product design and age verification, rather than relying on children and parents to protect themselves. (Source: Bloomberg)
